name: Aptus Value Housing Finance India Ltd.
about: Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited, together with its subsidiary, Aptus Finance India Private Limited, provides housing finance solutions against immovable properties in India. The company offers home and quasi-home loans for the purchase, construction, renovation, and extension of houses; loans against property for construction and purchase of houses; and secured, small business, and refinance loans. It serves shopkeepers, vendors mechanics, and traders; and semi-urban families rural households markets. Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
